description: React component for configuring conditional formatting options in a UI, including color schemes, column selection, and operator logic.

methods.name: targetValueValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator function to compare target and compare values with a rejection message.

methods.name: targetValueLeftValidator
methods.description: Validator to ensure left target value is smaller than right target value.

methods.name: targetValueRightValidator
methods.description: Validator to ensure right target value is greater than left target value.

methods.name: isOperatorMultiValue
methods.description: Checks if the operator supports multiple values.

methods.name: renderOperator
methods.description: Renders the operator selection form item based on column type.

methods.name: renderOperatorFields
methods.description: Renders input fields for operator configuration based on column type and operator.
